evidence.note: One projection writes failed from AsyncResult.isFailure, loading from isInitial&&waiting, and empty only on isSuccess with no turns. Those AsyncResult phases are exclusive, so two flags cannot be true together.
empty requires AsyncResult.isSuccess, which excludes both the failure phase and the initial waiting phase.

notes: Correction of the seeded cluster: streaming is O.Option<StreamingTurn>, not a boolean. Remaining flags are ready|loading|failed|empty.
